integrity: The countermodel is proved by closure of semantic truth-set algebras and direct implication evaluation; finite exhaustive checks are supplementary. No claim of expert or independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Extrinsic fixed-model bi-relational semantics only; not intrinsic forcing, not jointly confluent frames. World cardinality and depth are minimal; edge count and propositional-variable count are not claimed minimal. Older historical literature remains a residual priority uncertainty.
title: Separate modal persistence does not compose: a sharp three-world countermodel
